title: agoseris glauca var. villosa
intro: Agoseris glauca var. villosa, commonly known as Villose Mountain Sunflower, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family, native to western North America. The health benefits of Agoseris glauca var. villosa include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic agent, which can help to treat various health issues such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Agoseris glauca var. villosa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
